ST22-001.name: 艾斯＆紐蓋特
ST22-001.effect: 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】可以公開1張自己手牌中擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵的卡片：抽1張卡片，並將公開的卡片放置在卡組上面。
ST22-001.effect_en: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may reveal 1 card with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: Draw 1 card and place the revealed card at the top of your deck.

ST22-002.name: 以藏
ST22-002.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張除了「以藏」以外擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵的卡片，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。 【對方攻擊時】可將這張角色卡放置在廢棄區：抽1張卡片，並將1張自己的手牌放置在卡組下面。
ST22-002.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 card with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" other than [Izo] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [On Your Opponent's Attack] You may trash this Character: Draw 1 card and place 1 card from your hand at the bottom of your deck.

ST22-003.name: 艾德華・紐蓋特
ST22-003.effect: 【雙重攻擊】(這張卡片造成的傷害為2) 【登場時】公開1張自己卡組上面的卡片，若該張卡片擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵時，抽2張卡片。
ST22-003.effect_en: [Double Attack] (This card deals 2 damage.) [On Play] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", draw 2 cards.

ST22-005.name: 光月御田
ST22-005.effect: 這張角色卡因對手的效果即將離開場上時，可以替換成廢棄2張自己的手牌。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】可將3張自己的咚‼卡置為休息狀態，並將1張除了這張角色卡以外自己的角色卡放回持有者的手牌：將這張角色卡置為活動狀態。
ST22-005.effect_en: If this Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may trash 2 cards from your hand instead. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 3 of your DON!! cards and return 1 of your Characters other than this Character to the owner's hand: Set this Character as active.

ST22-006.name: 裘斯
ST22-006.effect: 【登場時】公開1張自己卡組上面的卡片，若該張卡片擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵時，抽2張卡片，並廢棄1張自己的手牌。
ST22-006.effect_en: [On Play] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.

ST22-007.name: 史庫亞德
ST22-007.effect: 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】公開1張自己卡組上面的卡片，若該張卡片擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵時，附加最多1張休息狀態的咚‼卡在1張自己的領航卡或角色卡。
ST22-007.effect_en: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

ST22-009.name: 比斯塔
ST22-009.effect: 【防禦】(對手攻擊後，將這張卡片置為休息狀態即可使攻擊的對象換成這張卡片)
ST22-009.effect_en: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

ST22-011.name: 雪白之珮
ST22-011.effect: 【我方回合中】【登場時】可以公開2張自己手牌中擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵的卡片：最多1張自己擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵的領航卡，在這個回合，力量值+2000。
ST22-011.effect_en: [Your Turn] [On Play] You may reveal 2 cards with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: Up to 1 of your Leader with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" gains +2000 power during this turn.

ST22-012.name: 馬可
ST22-012.effect: 【每回合1次】若這張角色卡因對手的效果遭到KO時，可以替換成廢棄1張自己的手牌。 【攻擊時】公開1張自己卡組上面的卡片，若該張卡片擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵時，這張角色卡，在下一個對手回合結束前，力量值+1000。
ST22-012.effect_en: [Once Per Turn] If this Character would be K.O.'d by your opponent's effect, you may trash 1 card from your hand instead. [When Attacking] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", this Character gains +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ST22-015.name: 我可是「白鬍子」啊!!!!
ST22-015.effect: 【主要】若自己的領航卡擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵時，使最多1張自己手牌中的「艾德華・紐蓋特」登場。之後，可將1張自己生命值區上面或下面的卡片加入手牌。若有執行此動作時，最多1張自己的領航卡，在下一個對手回合結束前，力量值+2000。
ST22-015.effect_en: [Main] If your Leader's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", play up to 1 [Edward.Newgate] from your hand. Then, you may add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand. If you do, up to 1 of your Leader gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn.

ST22-016.name: 給我收回……!!!剛剛那句話……!!!
ST22-016.effect:
【反擊】公開1張自己卡組上面的卡片，若該張卡片擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵時，最多1張自己的領航卡或角色卡，在這場對戰中，力量值+4000。
【觸發器】抽1張卡片。
ST22-016.name_en: Take That Back!! Take Back What You Said!!
ST22-016.effect_en:
[Counter] Reveal 1 card from the top of your deck. If that card's type includes "Whitebeard Pirates", up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +4000 power during this battle.
[Trigger] Draw 1 card.

ST22-017.name: 火拳
ST22-017.effect:
【主要】可以公開2張自己手牌中擁有包含『白鬍子海賊團』特徵的卡片：抽1張卡片。之後，將最多1張費用5以下的角色卡，放置到持有者的卡組下面。
【觸發器】將最多1張費用3以下的角色卡，放置到持有者的卡組下面。
ST22-017.effect_en:
[Main] You may reveal 2 cards with a type including "Whitebeard Pirates" from your hand: Draw 1 card. Then, place up to 1 Character with a cost of 5 or less at the bottom of the owner's deck.
[Trigger] Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 3 or less to the owner's hand.
ST22-017.trigger: 【觸發器】將最多1張費用3以下的角色卡，放置到持有者的卡組下面。
ST22-017.trigger_en: [Trigger] Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 3 or less to the owner's hand.

OP14-001.name: 托拉法爾加・羅
OP14-001.effect: 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】選擇2張自己擁有《超新星》或《哈特海賊團》特徵的角色卡。在這個回合，交換選擇的角色卡的原本力量值。
OP14-001.effect_en: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Select 2 of your {Supernovas} or {Heart Pirates} type Characters. Swap the base power of the selected Characters with each other during this turn.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP14-002.name: 烏魯基
OP14-002.effect: 【攻擊時】若這張角色卡的力量值5000以上時，抽1張卡片，並KO最多1張對手原本力量值3000以下的角色卡。
OP14-002.effect_en: [When Attacking] If this Character has 5000 power or more, draw 1 card and K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 base power or less.

OP14-003.name: 卡波涅・培基
OP14-003.effect: 這張角色卡不會因對手原本力量值5000以下的角色卡效果而遭到KO。
OP14-003.effect_en: This Character cannot be K.O.'d by effects of your opponent's Characters with 5000 base power or less.

OP14-004.name: 卡文迪許
OP14-004.effect: 若這張角色卡的力量值5000以上時，這張角色卡獲得【速攻】。 (這張卡片在登場的回合即可攻擊)
OP14-004.effect_en: If this Character has 5000 power or more, this Character gains [Rush]. (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

OP14-005.name: 奇拉
OP14-005.effect: 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】附加最多1張休息狀態的咚‼卡在1張自己的領航卡或角色卡。
OP14-005.effect_en: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

OP14-006.name: 夏奇＆企鵝

OP14-009.name: 托拉法爾加・羅
OP14-009.effect: 【速攻】 【對方攻擊時】【每回合1次】可以廢棄2張自己的手牌：選擇自己的領航卡和1張自己的角色卡。在這場對戰中，交換選擇的角色卡的原本力量值。
OP14-009.effect_en: [Rush] [On Your Opponent's Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may trash 2 cards from your hand: Select your Leader and 1 Character. Swap the base power of the selected cards with each other during this battle.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP14-010.name: 巴吉魯・霍金斯
OP14-010.effect: 【KO時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，使最多1張除了「巴吉魯・霍金斯」以外力量值2000以下擁有《超新星》特徵的角色卡登場。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。
OP14-010.effect_en: [On K.O.] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; play up to 1 {Supernovas} type Character card with 2000 power or less other than [Basil Hawkins]. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

OP14-011.name: 巴特洛馬
OP14-011.effect: 【咚‼×2】這張角色卡獲得【防禦】。 (對手攻擊後，將這張卡片置為休息狀態即可使攻擊的對象換成這張卡片)
OP14-011.effect_en: [DON!! x2] This Character gains [Blocker]. (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

OP14-012.name: 培波
OP14-012.effect: 【攻擊時】若這張角色卡的力量值5000以上時，附加最多2張休息狀態的咚‼卡在1張自己的領航卡或角色卡。
OP14-012.effect_en: [When Attacking] If this Character has 5000 power or more, give up to 2 rested DON!! cards to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

OP14-013.name: 蒙其・D・魯夫
OP14-013.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張除了「蒙其・D・魯夫」以外擁有《超新星》特徵的卡片，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。 【攻擊時】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-1000。
OP14-013.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Supernovas} type card other than [Monkey.D.Luffy] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −1000 power during this turn.

OP14-014.name: 尤斯塔斯・基德
OP14-014.effect: 【防禦】 【登場時】若自己的領航卡擁有《超新星》特徵時，使最多1張自己手牌中力量值2000以下紅色的角色卡登場。
OP14-014.effect_en: [Blocker] [On Play] If your Leader has the {Supernovas} type, play up to 1 red Character card with 2000 power or less from your hand.

OP14-015.name: 羅羅亞・索隆
OP14-015.effect: 【速攻】(這張卡片在登場的回合即可攻擊) 【攻擊時】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-1000。
OP14-015.effect_en: [Rush] (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.) [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −1000 power during this turn.

OP14-016.name: X・多雷古
OP14-016.effect: 【對方回合中】【每回合1次】若自己擁有《超新星》特徵的角色卡因對手的效果即將離開場上時，可以替換成自己的領航卡，在這個回合，力量值-2000。 【咚‼×1】【攻擊時】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-2000。
OP14-016.effect_en: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] If your {Supernovas} type Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may give your Leader −2000 power during this turn instead. [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

OP14-017.name: 移植
OP14-017.effect: 【主要】選擇2張對手原本力量值9000以下的角色卡。在這個回合，交換選擇的角色卡的原本力量值。
OP14-017.effect_en: [Main] Select 2 of your opponent's Characters with 9000 base power or less. Swap the base power of the selected Characters with each other during this turn.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP14-018.name: 開始反擊吧
OP14-018.effect:
【反擊】若場上有力量值8000以上的角色卡時，最多1張自己的領航卡或角色卡，在這場對戰中，力量值+4000。
【觸發器】使最多1張自己手牌中力量值2000以下紅色的角色卡登場。
OP14-018.effect_en:
[Counter] If there is a Character with 8000 power or more, up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +4000 power during this battle.
[Trigger] Play up to 1 red Character card with 2000 power or less from your hand.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
OP14-018.trigger: 【觸發器】使最多1張自己手牌中力量值2000以下紅色的角色卡登場。
OP14-018.trigger_en: [Trigger] Play up to 1 red Character card with 2000 power or less from your hand.

OP14-019.name: 我有個「計策」…能搞垮「四皇」之一!!!

【主要】從自己的卡組上面查看4張卡片，公開最多1張擁有《超新星》或《草帽一行人》特徵的角色卡，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。
【觸發器】抽1張卡片。
OP14-019.name_en: I Have a Plan to Take Down One of the Four Emperors!!
OP14-019.effect_en:
[Main] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Supernovas} or {Straw Hat Crew} type Character card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Trigger] Draw 1 card.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP14-020.name: 喬拉可爾・密佛格
OP14-020.effect: 若對手的領航卡擁有(斬)屬性時，這張領航卡的力量值+1000。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】可將1張自己的卡片置為休息狀態：若場上有費用5以上的角色卡時，將最多3張自己的咚‼卡置為活動狀態。之後，在這個回合，自己無法使角色卡登場。
OP14-020.effect_en: If your opponent's Leader has the <Slash> attribute, this Leader gains +1000 power. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your cards: If there is a Character with a cost of 5 or more, set up to 3 of your DON!! cards as active. Then, you cannot play Character cards during this turn.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP14-021.name: 一笑
OP14-021.effect: 【我方回合中】這張角色卡置為休息狀態時，可將1張自己生命值區上面的卡片加入手牌。若有執行此動作時，最多1張對手休息狀態的角色卡或舞台卡，在下一個對手的重整階段無法為活動狀態。
OP14-021.effect_en: [Your Turn] When this Character becomes rested, you may add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand. If you do, up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters or Stages will not become active in your opponent's next Refresh Phase.

OP14-022.name: 騙人布
OP14-022.effect: 【我方回合結束時】若自己的領航卡擁有《FILM》或《草帽一行人》特徵時，將最多2張自己的咚‼卡置為活動狀態。
OP14-022.effect_en: [End of Your Turn] If your Leader has the {FILM} or {Straw Hat Crew} type, set up to 2 of your DON!! cards as active.

OP14-023.name: 菊之丞
OP14-023.effect: 【我方回合結束時】將這張角色卡置為活動狀態。
OP14-023.effect_en: [End of Your Turn] Set this Character as active.

OP14-024.name: 錦右衛門
OP14-024.effect: 【登場時】將最多3張自己的咚‼卡置為活動狀態。之後，在這個回合，自己無法使角色卡登場。 【KO時】將最多1張對手的卡片置為休息狀態。
OP14-024.effect_en: [On Play] Set up to 3 of your DON!! cards as active. Then, you cannot play Character cards during this turn. [On K.O.] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's cards.

OP14-025.name: 克洛
OP14-025.effect: 【登場時】若自己的領航卡是「克洛」時，使最多1張自己手牌中費用6以下擁有《東方藍》特徵的角色卡登場。
OP14-025.effect_en: [On Play] If your Leader is [Kuro], play up to 1 {East Blue} type Character card with a cost of 6 or less from your hand.

OP14-026.name: 光月御田
OP14-026.effect: 【對方回合中】若這張角色卡在休息狀態時，這張角色卡的力量值+2000。
OP14-026.effect_en: [Opponent's Turn] If this Character is rested, this Character gains +2000 power.

OP14-027.name: 傑克
OP14-027.effect: 【我方回合中】這張角色卡置為休息狀態時，將最多1張對手原本力量值7000以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。 【對方回合中】若這張角色卡在休息狀態時，對手的角色卡全數力量值-1000。
OP14-027.effect_en: [Your Turn] When this Character becomes rested, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 7000 base power or less. [Opponent's Turn] If this Character is rested, give all of your opponent's Characters −1000 power.

OP14-028.name: 強尼
OP14-028.effect: 【我方回合中】這張角色卡置為休息狀態時，KO最多1張對手休息狀態費用2以下的角色卡。
OP14-028.effect_en: [Your Turn] When this Character becomes rested, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 2 or less.

OP14-029.name: 達絲琪
OP14-029.effect: 【對方回合中】若這張角色卡因對手的效果即將離開場上時，可以替換成將1張自己的卡片置為休息狀態。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】可將2張自己的卡片置為休息狀態：這張角色卡，在下一個對手回合結束前，力量值+2000。
OP14-029.effect_en: [Opponent's Turn] If this Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may rest 1 of your cards instead. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 2 of your cards: This Character gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

OP14-031.name: 娜美

OP14-031.effect_en: [Blocker] [On Play] Rest up to 2 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 8 or less. Then, set up to 5 of your DON!! cards as active at the end of this turn.

OP14-032.name: 人鬼狒
OP14-032.effect: 【我方回合中】這張角色卡置為休息狀態時，將最多1張對手費用4以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。
OP14-032.effect_en: [Your Turn] When this Character becomes rested, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

OP14-033.name: 培羅娜

P-117.effect: 在規則上，自己只可以將擁有《東方藍》特徵的卡片放入卡組，若自己的卡組為0張卡片時，自己將獲勝而非輸掉遊戲。 【咚‼×1】因為這張領航卡的攻擊，而造成對手生命值傷害時，可將1張自己卡組上面的卡片放置在廢棄區。
P-117.effect_en: Under the rules of this game, you can only include {East Blue} type cards in your deck and when your deck is reduced to 0, you win the game instead of losing. [DON!! x1] When this Leader's attack deals damage to your opponent's Life, you may trash 1 card from the top of your deck.

EB03-001.name: 納菲魯塔利・薇薇
EB03-001.effect: 【每回合1次】若自己原本費用4以上的角色卡即將遭到KO時，可以替換成廢棄1張自己的手牌。 【啟動主要】可將這張領航卡置為休息狀態：最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-2000。之後，最多1張自己未持有【攻擊時】效果的角色卡，在這個回合，獲得【速攻】。
EB03-001.effect_en: [Once Per Turn] If your Character with a base cost of 4 or more would be K.O.'d, you may trash 1 card from your hand instead. [Activate: Main] You may rest this Leader: Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn. Then, up to 1 of your Characters without a [When Attacking] effect gains [Rush] during this turn.

EB03-003.name: 美音
EB03-003.effect: 【登場時】若自己的領航卡是「美音」時，抽2張卡片。之後，使最多1張自己手牌中力量值6000以下原本沒有效果的角色卡登場。
EB03-003.effect_en: [On Play] If your Leader is [Uta], draw 2 cards. Then, play up to 1 Character card with 6000 power or less and no base effect from your hand.

EB03-004.name: 卡莉娜

EB03-004.effect_en: [Blocker] [Opponent's Turn] If your Leader is multicolored and you have no Characters with 6000 base power or more, this Character gains +4000 power.

EB03-005.name: 砂糖

EB03-005.effect_en: [On Play] If your Leader is [Sugar], play up to 1 {Donquixote Pirates} type Character card with 6000 power or less from your hand rested.

EB03-006.name: 娜美

EB03-007.name: 芭卡拉

EB03-008.name: 雲雀

EB03-008.effect_en: [On Play]/[When Attacking] Up to 1 of your {SWORD} type Leader or Character cards can also attack active Characters during this turn. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −1000 power during this turn.

EB03-009.name: 瑪姬

EB03-011.name: 下次見面的時候…你們還會叫我夥伴嗎？

【觸發器】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-2000。
EB03-011.name_en: But If We Ever See Each Other Again... Will You Call Me Your Shipmate?!!

[Counter] If your Leader is [Nefeltari Vivi], up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +4000 power during this battle.
[Trigger] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

EB03-015.name: 海咪

EB03-016.name: 光月日和
EB03-016.effect: 【登場時】若自己的領航卡是「光月御田」時，抽1張卡片。 【啟動主要】可將這張角色卡放置在廢棄區：附加最多1張休息狀態的咚‼卡在自己擁有《和之國》特徵的領航卡。
EB03-016.effect_en: [On Play] If your Leader is [Kouzuki Oden], draw 1 card. [Activate: Main] You may trash this Character: Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your {Land of Wano} type Leader.

EB03-017.name: 珠寶・波妮

EB03-019.effect_en: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

EB03-024.name: 納菲魯塔利・薇薇

EB03-028.name: 小悠

EB03-037.effect_en: [On Play] If you have 7 or more DON!! cards on your field, all of your {ODYSSEY} type Leader and Character cards gain +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

EB03-038.name: 多謝招待♡

EB03-041.effect_en: [Opponent's Turn] All of your {SWORD} type Characters with a cost of 6 or less gain +2000 power. [On Play] You may trash 1 {Navy} type card from your hand: Draw 2 cards.

PRB02-011.name: 唐吉訶德・多佛朗明哥

PRB02-013.name: 月光・摩利亞

PRB02-015.name: 矢龍

PRB02-016.name: 玉兒

【啟動主要】可將這張角色卡置為休息狀態，並將1張自己生命值區上面或下面的卡片加入手牌：最多1張自己的領航卡或角色卡，在這個回合，力量值+3000。

PRB02-016.effect_en:
[Activate: Main] You may rest this Character and add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this turn.
[Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.
PRB02-016.trigger: 【觸發器】將最多1張對手費用4以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。
PRB02-016.trigger_en: [Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

PRB02-017.name: 波雅・漢考克
PRB02-017.effect:
【登場時】可以廢棄1張自己手牌中持有【觸發器】的卡片：最多1張對手休息狀態的領航卡、或除了「蒙其・D・魯夫」以外對手的角色卡，在下一個對手結束階段結束前，無法進行攻擊。
【觸發器】KO最多1張對手費用4以下的角色卡。
card_sets: ONE PIECE CARD THE BEST vol.2【PRB-02】
PRB02-017.effect_en:
[On Play] You may trash 1 card with a [Trigger] from your hand: Your opponent's rested Leader or up to 1 of your opponent's Characters other than [Monkey.D.Luffy] cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.
[Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP15-001.name: 克利克
OP15-001.effect: 【咚‼×1】【對方回合中】若自己的角色卡只有擁有《東方藍》特徵的角色卡時，對手的角色卡全數力量值-2000。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】將最多1張對手已附加2張以上咚‼卡的角色卡置為休息狀態。
OP15-001.effect_en: [DON!! x1] [Opponent's Turn] If the only Characters on your field are {East Blue} type Characters, give all of your opponent's Characters −2000 power. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters that has 2 or more DON!! cards given.

OP15-002.name: 魯西

This Leader gains +1000 power during this battle for every card trashed. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If you have activated an Event with a base cost of 3 or more during this turn, draw 1 card.

[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may give 1 of your opponent's rested DON!! cards to 1 of your opponent's Characters: Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to its owner's Leader or 1 of their Characters.

[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If this Character was played on this turn, give all of your opponent's Characters −1000 power during this turn for every DON!! card given to that Character.

OP11-021.name: 吉貝爾

OP11-022.name: 白星

[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-up: Play up to 1 {Neptunian} type Character card or [Megalo] with a cost equal to or less than the number of DON!! cards on your field from your hand.

OP11-023.name: 惡龍

OP12-015-P1.effect: 若自己已附加的咚‼卡合計2張以上時，這張角色卡的力量值+2000。 【登場時】可以公開2張自己手牌中的事件卡：使最多1張自己手牌中力量值3000以下紅色的角色卡登場。之後，附加最多1張休息狀態的咚‼卡在1張自己的領航卡或角色卡。
OP12-015-P1.effect_en: If you have a total of 2 or more given DON!! cards, this Character gains +2000 power. [On Play] You may reveal 2 Events from your hand: Play up to 1 red Character card with 3000 power or less from your hand. Then, give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

OP12-020-P1.name: 羅羅亞・索隆
OP12-020-P1.effect: 【咚‼×3】【啟動主要】【每回合1次】在這個回合，若這張領航卡和對手的角色卡對戰時，將這張領航卡置為活動狀態。之後，這張領航卡，在這個回合，無法攻擊對手原本費用7以下的角色卡。
OP12-020-P1.effect_en: [DON!! x3] [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If this Leader battles your opponent's Character during this turn, set this Leader as active. Then, this Leader cannot attack your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 7 or less during this turn.

OP12-030-P1.name: 喬拉可爾・密佛格
OP12-030-P1.effect: 【防禦】 【登場時】將最多4張自己的咚‼卡置為活動狀態。之後，在這個回合，自己無法使原本費用7以上的角色卡登場。
OP12-030-P1.effect_en: [Blocker] [On Play] Set up to 4 of your DON!! cards as active. Then, you cannot play Character cards with a base cost of 7 or more during this turn.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP12-031-P1.name: 達絲琪
OP12-031-P1.effect: 【登場時】將最多1張對手原本費用6以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。之後，附加最多3張休息狀態的咚‼卡在自己的領航卡「羅羅亞・索隆」。
OP12-031-P1.effect_en: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 6 or less. Then, give up to 3 rested DON!! cards to your [Roronoa Zoro] Leader.

OP12-034-P1.name: 培羅娜
OP12-034-P1.effect: 【登場時】若自己的領航卡擁有(斬)屬性時，從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張擁有(斬)屬性的卡片或綠色的事件卡，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。
OP12-034-P1.effect_en: [On Play] If your Leader has the <Slash> attribute, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 <Slash> attribute card or green Event and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

OP12-037-P1.name: 鬼氣 九刀流 阿修羅 拔劍 亡者戲
OP12-037-P1.effect: 【主要】可將3張自己的咚‼卡置為休息狀態：將合計最多2張對手的角色卡或咚‼卡置為休息狀態。 【反擊】自己的領航卡，在這場對戰中，力量值+3000。
OP12-037-P1.name_en: Demon Aura Nine Sword Style Asura Blades Drawn Dead Man's Game
OP12-037-P1.effect_en: [Main] You may rest 3 of your DON!! cards: Rest up to a total of 2 of your opponent's Characters or DON!! cards. [Counter] Your Leader gains +3000 power during this battle.

OP12-040-P1.name: 庫山
OP12-040-P1.effect: 因自己擁有《海軍》特徵的卡片效果而廢棄自己手牌中的卡片時，抽取與廢棄卡片相同數量的卡片。
OP12-040-P1.effect_en: When a card is trashed from your hand by your {Navy} type card's effect, draw cards equal to the number of cards trashed.

OP12-041-P1.name: 香吉士
OP12-041-P1.effect: 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】咚‼-1：發動最多1張自己手牌中原本費用3以下擁有《草帽一行人》特徵的事件卡。 【攻擊時】若自己場上的咚‼卡少於等於對手場上的咚‼卡時，從咚‼卡組追加最多1張休息狀態的咚‼卡。
OP12-041-P1.effect_en: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] DON!! −1: Activate up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew} type Event with a base cost of 3 or less from your hand. [When Attacking] If the number of DON!! cards on your field is equal to or less than the number on your opponent's field, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and rest it.

OP12-043-P1.name: 庫山
OP12-043-P1.effect: 若自己的手牌在5張以上時，這張角色卡的費用+1。 【登場時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：最多1張對手的角色卡，在下一個對手結束階段結束前，無法進行攻擊。
OP12-043-P1.effect_en: If you have 5 or more cards in your hand, this Character gains +1 cost. [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Up to 1 of your opponent's Characters cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

OP12-056-P1.name: 蒙其・D・卡普
OP12-056-P1.effect: 【登場時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：使最多1張自己手牌中除了「蒙其・D・卡普」以外力量值8000以下藍色擁有《海軍》特徵的角色卡登場。
OP12-056-P1.effect_en: [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Play up to 1 blue {Navy} type Character card with 8000 power or less other than [Monkey.D.Garp] from your hand.

OP12-060-P1.name: 牛肉BURST
OP12-060-P1.effect: 【主要】若自己的領航卡有多種顏色時，選擇下列其中一項。 ・將最多1張對手費用4以下的角色卡放回持有者的手牌。 ・若自己的手牌在6張以下時，抽2張卡片。
OP12-060-P1.effect_en: [Main] If your Leader is multicolored, choose one: • Return up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less to the owner's hand. • If you have 6 or less cards in your hand, draw 2 cards.

OP12-061-P1.name: 唐吉訶德・羅希南特
OP12-061-P1.effect: 【每回合1次】若自己的「托拉法爾加・羅」即將遭到KO時，可以替換成將1張自己生命值區上面的卡片加入手牌。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】咚‼-1：在這個回合，接下來使自己手牌中費用4以上的「托拉法爾加・羅」登場的支付費用減少2。
OP12-061-P1.effect_en: [Once Per Turn] If your [Trafalgar Law] would be K.O.'d, you may add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand instead. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] DON!! −1: The next time you play [Trafalgar Law] with a cost of 4 or more from your hand during this turn, the cost will be reduced by 2.

OP12-063-P1.name: 賓什莫克・麗珠
OP12-063-P1.effect: 若自己廢棄區有4張以上事件卡時，這張角色卡的力量值+2000、費用+5。 【防禦】(對手攻擊後，將這張卡片置為休息狀態即可使攻擊的對象換成這張卡片)
OP12-063-P1.effect_en: If you have 4 or more Events in your trash, this Character gains +2000 power and +5 cost. [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

OP12-070-P1.name: 香吉士
OP12-070-P1.effect: 自己廢棄區中每有5張事件卡，這張角色卡，力量值+1000。 這張角色卡因對手的效果即將離開場上時，可以替換成將1張自己場上的咚‼卡放回咚‼卡組。
OP12-070-P1.effect_en: This Character gains +1000 power for every 5 Events in your trash. If this Character would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may return 1 DON!! card from your field to your DON!! deck instead.

OP12-073-P1.name: 托拉法爾加・羅
OP12-073-P1.effect: 【登場時】若自己場上的咚‼卡少於等於對手場上的咚‼卡時，從自己的咚‼卡組追加最多1張活動狀態的咚‼卡。之後，自己的「唐吉訶德・羅希南特」和自己擁有《哈特海賊團》特徵的角色卡全數，在下一個對手結束階段結束前，力量值+1000。
OP12-073-P1.effect_en: [On Play] If the number of DON!! cards on your field is equal to or less than the number on your opponent's field, add up to 1 DON!! card from your DON!! deck and set it as active. Then, all of your [Donquixote Rosinante] and {Heart Pirates} type Characters gain +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

OP12-081-P1.name: 可亞拉
OP12-081-P1.effect: 這張領航卡攻擊對手的領航卡時，若場上有2張以上自己費用8以上的角色卡時，抽1張卡片。 【每回合1次】對手使原本費用8以上的角色卡登場時、或對手因角色卡的效果使角色卡登場時，可以發動。對手將1張自身生命值區上面的卡片加入手牌。
OP12-081-P1.effect_en: When this Leader attacks your opponent's Leader, if you have 2 or more Characters with a cost of 8 or more, draw 1 card. [Once Per Turn] This effect can be activated when your opponent plays a Character with a base cost of 8 or more, or when your opponent plays a Character using a Character's effect. Your opponent adds 1 card from the top of their Life cards to their hand.

OP12-086-P1.name: 可亞拉
OP12-086-P1.effect: 【登場時】若自己的領航卡擁有《革命軍》特徵時，從自己的卡組上面查看3張卡片，公開最多1張除了「可亞拉」以外擁有《革命軍》特徵的卡片或「妮可・羅賓」，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片放到廢棄區。
OP12-086-P1.effect_en: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Revolutionary Army} type, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type card other than [Koala] or up to 1 [Nico Robin] and add it to your hand. Then, trash the rest.

OP12-087-P1.name: 妮可・羅賓
OP12-087-P1.effect: 若自己的領航卡是「可亞拉」或「蒙其・D・魯夫」時，這張角色卡獲得【防禦】、費用+3。 【登場時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：若對手的手牌有5張以上時，對手廢棄2張自身的手牌。
OP12-087-P1.effect_en: If your Leader is [Koala] or [Monkey.D.Luffy], this Character gains [Blocker] and +3 cost. [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, your opponent trashes 2 cards from their hand.

OP12-094-P1.name: 蒙其・D・多拉格
OP12-094-P1.effect: 【登場時】可將3張自己廢棄區中擁有《革命軍》特徵的卡片依任意順序放置在卡組下面：若自己的領航卡擁有《革命軍》特徵時，使最多1張自己廢棄區中費用6以下的角色卡登場。
OP12-094-P1.effect_en: [On Play] You may place 3 {Revolutionary Army} type cards from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order: If your Leader has the {Revolutionary Army} type, play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 6 or less from your trash.

OP12-102-P1.name: 白星公主
OP12-102-P1.effect: 自己原本費用6以下的角色卡因對手的效果即將離開場上時，可以替換成將1張自己生命值區上面的卡片翻成正面朝上。 【對方回合中】若場上沒有自己其他原本費用2的「白星公主」時，自己擁有《海王類》特徵的角色卡全數力量值+2000。
OP12-102-P1.effect_en: If your Character with a base cost of 6 or less would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-up instead. [Opponent's Turn] If you have no other [Shirahoshi] with a base cost of 2, all of your {Neptunian} type Characters gain +2000 power.

OP12-108-P1.name: 唐吉訶德・羅希南特
OP12-108-P1.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張「托拉法爾加・羅」，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。
OP12-108-P1.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 [Trafalgar Law] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

OP12-118-P1.name: 珠寶・波妮
OP12-118-P1.effect: 【防禦】 【登場時】若自己休息狀態的卡片有8張以上時，抽2張卡片，並廢棄1張自己的手牌。之後，將最多1張自己的咚‼卡置為活動狀態。
OP12-118-P1.effect_en: [Blocker] [On Play] If you have 8 or more rested cards, draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand. Then, set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.

OP12-118-P2.name: 珠寶・波妮
OP12-118-P2.effect: 【防禦】 【登場時】若自己休息狀態的卡片有8張以上時，抽2張卡片，並廢棄1張自己的手牌。之後，將最多1張自己的咚‼卡置為活動狀態。
OP12-118-P2.effect_en: [Blocker] [On Play] If you have 8 or more rested cards, draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand. Then, set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.

OP12-119-P1.name: 巴索羅繆・大熊
OP12-119-P1.effect: 【登場時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：將最多1張自己卡組上面的卡片加入生命值區上面。之後，這張角色卡，在下一個對手結束階段結束前，費用+2。 【對方回合中】【KO時】將最多1張自己卡組上面的卡片加入生命值區上面。
OP12-119-P1.effect_en: [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards. Then, this Character gains +2 cost until the end of your opponent's next End Phase. [Opponent's Turn] [On K.O.] Add up to 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.
traits_en: The Seven Warlords of the Sea

OP06-050-P2.name: 達絲琪
OP06-050-P2.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張除了「達絲琪」以外擁有《海軍》特徵的卡片，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。
OP06-050-P2.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Navy} type card other than [Tashigi] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

OP09-013-P1.name: 耶穌布
OP09-013-P1.effect: 【登場時】最多1張自己的領航卡，在下一個對手回合結束前，力量值+1000。 【咚‼×1】【攻擊時】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-1000。
OP09-013-P1.effect_en: [On Play] Up to 1 of your Leader gains +1000 power until the end of your opponent's next turn. [DON!! x1] [When Attacking] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −1000 power during this turn.

OP09-037-P2.name: 莉姆
OP09-037-P2.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張除了「莉姆」以外擁有《ODYSSEY》特徵的卡片，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。 【我方回合結束時】若場上有3張以上自己休息狀態的角色卡時，將這張角色卡置為活動狀態。
OP09-037-P2.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {ODYSSEY} type card other than [Lim] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [End of Your Turn] If you have 3 or more rested Characters, set this Character as active.

OP09-093-P4.name: 馬歇爾・D・汀奇
OP09-093-P4.effect: 【防禦】 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】若自己的領航卡擁有《黑鬍子海賊團》特徵、而且是這張角色卡登場的回合時，最多1張對手的領航卡，在這個回合，效果無效。之後，最多1張對手的角色卡，在下一個對手回合結束前，效果無效、而且該張角色卡無法進行攻擊。
OP09-093-P4.effect_en: [Blocker] [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If your Leader has the {Blackbeard Pirates} type and this Character was played on this turn, negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Leader during this turn. Then, negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Characters and that Character cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next turn.

OP09-093-P5.name: 馬歇爾・D・汀奇
OP09-093-P5.effect: 【防禦】 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】若自己的領航卡擁有《黑鬍子海賊團》特徵、而且是這張角色卡登場的回合時，最多1張對手的領航卡，在這個回合，效果無效。之後，最多1張對手的角色卡，在下一個對手回合結束前，效果無效、而且該張角色卡無法進行攻擊。
OP09-093-P5.effect_en: [Blocker] [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If your Leader has the {Blackbeard Pirates} type and this Character was played on this turn, negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Leader during this turn. Then, negate the effect of up to 1 of your opponent's Characters and that Character cannot attack until the end of your opponent's next turn.

OP10-082-P2.name: 庫山
OP10-082-P2.effect: 這張角色卡不會因對手的效果而離開場上。 【啟動主要】可將這張角色卡放置在廢棄區：抽1張卡片。之後，使最多1張自己廢棄區中除了「庫山」以外費用5以下擁有《黑鬍子海賊團》特徵的角色卡登場。
OP10-082-P2.effect_en: This Character cannot be removed from the field by your opponent's effects. [Activate: Main] You may trash this Character: Draw 1 card. Then, play up to 1 {Blackbeard Pirates} type Character card with a cost of 5 or less other than [Kuzan] from your trash.

ST13-011-P2.name: 波特卡斯・D・艾斯
ST13-011-P2.effect: 【登場時】若自己的生命值卡在2張以下時，這張角色卡獲得【速攻】。 (這張卡片在登場的回合即可攻擊)
ST13-011-P2.effect_en: [On Play] If you have 2 or less Life cards, this Character gains [Rush]. (This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

ST18-004-P1.name: 索隆十郎
ST18-004-P1.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張紫色擁有《草帽一行人》特徵的卡片，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。
ST18-004-P1.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 purple {Straw Hat Crew} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

OP11-001-P1.name: 克比
OP11-001-P1.effect: 自己擁有《SWORD》特徵的角色卡，在登場的回合即可攻擊角色卡。 【每回合1次】自己原本力量值7000以下擁有《海軍》特徵的角色卡因對手的效果即將離開場上時，可以替換成將3張自己廢棄區中的卡片依任意順序放置在卡組下面。
OP11-001-P1.effect_en: Your {SWORD} type Characters can attack Characters on the turn in which they are played. [Once Per Turn] If your {Navy} type Character with 7000 base power or less would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may place 3 cards from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order instead.

OP11-004-P1.name: 孔雀
OP11-004-P1.effect: 【登場時】從自己的卡組上面查看5張卡片，公開最多1張除了「孔雀」以外擁有《海軍》特徵的卡片，並加入手牌。之後，將其餘卡片依任意順序放到卡組下面。 【啟動主要】可將這張角色卡放置在廢棄區：最多1張自己的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值+1000。
OP11-004-P1.effect_en: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Navy} type card other than [Kujyaku] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. [Activate: Main] You may trash this Character: Up to 1 of your Characters gains +1000 power during this turn.

OP11-008-P1.name: 朵爾
OP11-008-P1.effect: 【防禦】 【登場時】可以廢棄1張自己的手牌：若自己的領航卡擁有《海軍》特徵時，最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-6000。
OP11-008-P1.effect_en: [Blocker] [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your Leader has the {Navy} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −6000 power during this turn.

OP11-010-P1.name: 雲雀
OP11-010-P1.effect: 【登場時】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-2000。 【攻擊時】這張角色卡，在這個回合，力量值+1000。之後，最多1張自己擁有《海軍》特徵的領航卡，在這個回合，可以攻擊活動狀態的角色卡。
OP11-010-P1.effect_en: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn. [When Attacking] This Character gains +1000 power during this turn. Then, up to 1 of your {Navy} type Leader can also attack active Characters during this turn.

OP11-018-P1.name: 誠實拳骨
OP11-018-P1.effect:
【主要】最多1張對手的角色卡，在這個回合，力量值-4000。之後，KO最多1張對手力量值6000以下的角色卡。
【觸發器】KO最多1張對手力量值6000以下的角色卡。
OP11-018-P1.effect_en:
[Main] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −4000 power during this turn. Then, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 6000 power or less.
[Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 6000 power or less.
OP11-018-P1.trigger: 【觸發器】KO最多1張對手力量值6000以下的角色卡。
OP11-018-P1.trigger_en: [Trigger] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 6000 power or less.

OP11-021-P1.name: 吉貝爾
OP11-021-P1.effect: 【我方回合結束時】若自己的手牌在6張以下時，將最多1張自己擁有《魚人族》或《人魚族》特徵的角色卡和最多1張自己的咚‼卡，置為活動狀態。
OP11-021-P1.effect_en: [End of Your Turn] If you have 6 or less cards in your hand, set up to 1 of your {Fish-Man} or {Merfolk} type Characters and up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.

OP11-022-P1.name: 白星
OP11-022-P1.effect: 這張領航卡無法攻擊。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】可將1張自己的咚‼卡置為休息狀態，並將1張自己生命值區上面的卡片翻成正面朝上：使最多1張自己手牌中費用數值在自己場上的咚‼卡張數以下、擁有《海王類》特徵的角色卡或「梅卡洛」登場。
OP11-022-P1.effect_en: This Leader cannot attack. [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and turn 1 card from the top of your Life cards face-up: Play up to 1 {Neptunian} type Character card or [Megalo] with a cost equal to or less than the number of DON!! cards on your field from your hand.

OP11-023-P1.name: 惡龍
OP11-023-P1.effect:
若自己的領航卡擁有《魚人族》特徵、自己的生命值卡在3張以下、而且對手休息狀態的卡片有5張以上時，手牌中這張卡片的費用-3。
【觸發器】將最多1張對手費用4以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。
OP11-023-P1.effect_en:
If your Leader has the {Fish-Man} type, you have 3 or less Life cards and your opponent has 5 or more rested cards, give this card in your hand −3 cost.
[Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.
OP11-023-P1.trigger: 【觸發器】將最多1張對手費用4以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。
OP11-023-P1.trigger_en: [Trigger] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

OP11-031-P1.name: 吉貝爾
OP11-031-P1.effect: 【登場時】若自己的領航卡擁有《魚人族》或《人魚族》特徵時，將最多1張對手費用5以下的角色卡置為休息狀態。 【啟動主要】【每回合1次】最多1張自己擁有《魚人族》或《人魚族》特徵的角色卡，在登場的回合即可攻擊角色卡。

[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Up to 1 of your {Fish-Man} or {Merfolk} type Characters can attack Characters on the turn in which it is played.

OP11-040-P1.name: 蒙其・D・魯夫

If you have 8 or more DON!! cards on your field, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the top or bottom of the deck in any order.
